name: flight-booking-app
description: Flight search and booking app (Vue 3 + Express + PostgreSQL + Duffel)

scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build --remove-orphans --wait && docker compose logs --no-log-prefix frontend | grep -A4 'SkyRoute is running'
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
